entry.name: jit.pack
entry.digest: Make a multiplane matrix out of single plane matrices
entry.description: The jit.pack object merges N single-plane matrices to make one N-plane matrix. This is useful for combining separate alpha, red, green, and blue matrices to make one ARGB matrix, and similar types of merging.

arguments.name: planecount
arguments.description: The number of planes in the input matrix and the number of single plane matrix inlets for theobject.
